paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2, Rabbi Levi said: a genealogical scroll was found in Jerusalem, and in it was written: “Ben Kovisin, of Ahab’s line.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied בירושלמי is understood as “in Jerusalem” in the scroll’s discovery report, supported by the Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2 wording בירושלם. This lexical reading does not prove the history of the supplied letters or the scroll’s genealogy.

The saved whole Guggenheimer Taanit 4:2 paragraph fully names Rabbi Levi and reports a scroll found in Jerusalem with Ben Kovisin from Ahab. The supplied בירושלמי remains in the Hebrew; this digital comparison does not establish the history of those letters or independently admit the genealogy.
